entities.summary: Karakhanid, a notable figure in the history of Kyrgyzstan, associated with Turkic Khaganates and Kyrgyz Origins (940–1207). Preceded by Karakhanid Islamization and Yenisei Kyrgyz Great Power. Their legacy influenced Yusuf Balasaguni composes the Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory) in Balasagun and Genghis Khan subjugates the Kyrgyz tribes of the Yenisei region.
